'''Stormtrooper snipers''', also known as '''Stormsnipers''', were elite [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] specialized in the use of [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]]. They distinguished themselves from other stormtroopers by wearing [[Color/Legends|blue]] or white [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]] over their right shoulder.<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Assault Team" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], multiple garrisons of stormtrooper snipers were stationed on the planets such as [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and even [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]] such as the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="Assault Team" /> They could also be found patrolling [[City/Legends|cities]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], including [[Kaadara]] and [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Equipment==
As their name suggests, Stormtrooper snipers received special training in the use of [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]], their main weapon being the [[RT-97C heavy blaster rifle/Legends|RT-97C heavy blaster rifles]]. They also carried [[Baradium-core code key thermal detonator]]s as part of their equipment, though they did not use them in battle.<ref name="Assault Team" />

The Stormtrooper Snipers' armor was basic [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], albeit slightly stronger and more durable.<ref name="Assault Team" />
